$doc: Molly's look choices (flagship skin s8/s10): one settings key per choice, kept in step with the live look by src/molly/look.ts, and set from outside by the molly-menus console plugin (REST, MCP, CLI, voice) through Molly's look document on axHub. kind: skin = the Use skin switch and skin id ('own' = off); mode = day / night (the flagship day or night skin while one is on, else the flagship colour theme); slot = the asset in one slot. The menu rows (src/assets/app-menu/molly.json, src/assets/context-menu/molly.json) offer the same values.
